Cherry Ice Cream Cone
By: vickyart
Published: Friday, July 30, 2010 - 2:08am

Ingredients




100 grams of cream
1 jar of low-fat cherry yogurt
1 tablespoon of liqueur alkermes
almonds
60 grams of dark chocolate

Preparation

1 First we create a cone with parchment paper and close with paper tape from the outside to keep it closed .. 2 Melt chocolate in a double boiler, place in a small syringe with nozzle and make the decorations in the cone, streaks ... and place in freezer while preparing the rest .. 3 Whip cream, add the yogurt, then grain and cherries, mix all, we take the cone and pour the mixture .. decorate with chocolate chips and grain .. 4 Put in freezer a few hours ... 5 Bon appetit!

About


A delicious cherry cone. Simple, fast and I would also say to do, you can prepare coffee, chocolate, strawberry, pineapple, peach ..
